summary: A notification pointing at what waits for a person went out, with the counts it carried and what each channel did with it.

counts.description: How many things of each sort the notification pointed at; never what they said.

protective_failures.description: Protective work that failed since the last notification that reached anybody.

event_gaps.description: Accounts whose provider events went unread for a span.

held.description: Work items waiting on a daily limit of launches as the notification was sent, in every campaign.

covered_through.description: The journal line the notification counted through, or null where it counted none.

channels.description: What each channel did with the notification.

channel.description: The channel's name, as the notification settings give it.

kind.description: A desktop toast, or a plugin's delivery.

code.description: Why a failed delivery failed, as the channel reported it.

class.description: The class of a failed delivery's failure.

reason.description: Why a channel was silenced or not tried, such as off, no_desktop, not_declared, unavailable, binding_invalid or one of the operating system's disabled_ words.

detail.description: A diagnostic about the delivery, never what the notification said.

receipt.description: The plugin's own identifier for the message it sent.

attempts.description: How many times the channel was tried; absent where it was not tried.

last_delivered_at.description: When a notification last reached anybody, this one included, or null where none has yet.

delivered_through.description: The line the last notification that reached anybody counted through, carried forward by one that reached nobody.
